summary: npx <tool> fails for every agent in this cloud session — npm rejects node v26.8.0-alpha.0.0.0 against the repo's devEngines.runtime ^26, so npx coherence/oxfmt/oxlint all error EBADDEVENGINES
evidence: npm error EBADDEVENGINES Invalid semver version 'v26.8.0-alpha.0.0.0' does not match '^26' for 'runtime'. Three separate subagents lost their decision journal to this and reported it independently. Workaround: ./node_modules/.bin/<tool> from the repo root. Now documented under Runtime Gotchas in AGENTS.md

summary: RULES_METHOD is hardcoded 'rules@1' while CLASSIFIER_VERSION is 2, so every rules-derived label row misreports the classifier version in its method tail
evidence: packages/food/src/classifiers/shared.ts:12 exports RULES_METHOD = 'rules@1' as a literal; packages/food/src/classify.ts:54 exports CLASSIFIER_VERSION = 2. Nothing derives one from the other, so a v2 classifier writes rows tagged rules@1. NOT confirmed against field data: the local dev database has zero rows in recipe_enrichment_label and recipe_enrichment (verified by query), so this is a code-read conclusion rather than a field observation. Does NOT affect the llm: prefix source check the tags UI relies on — that only tests the prefix, never the tail — but it does make the method string shown in the tag tooltip's title attribute wrong about which classifier produced the row
